channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: US Tracking Cyber Threats Against Nearly 20 Ships Worldwide
item.description: US government agencies are tracking cyber threats against nearly 20 shipping vessels around the world, according to US officials familiar with the situation.

item.title: JD Vance says Iran war will enter ‘much different phase’ in coming months
item.description: The US vice president did not provide a specific timeline for an end to US military involvement or say what form the next phase would take.

item.title: Charlie Kirk assassination: The security failures alleged by his family, explained
item.description: The potential civil case is separate from the criminal prosecution of Tyler Robinson, who is accused of shooting Kirk from the roof of the university's student resource center.

item.title: US Indictment Exposes Russian Global Assassination Network
item.description: Last year, a former military officer in the Russian intelligence services named Yuri Khrameev offered $25,000 to a US citizen to track and kill someone in Lithuania’s capital who was “telling lies about Russia,” according to US prosecutors.

item.title: Gen Z learns about money from Instagram, YouTube: Entrepreneur asks banks to learn how to communicate with young people
item.description: Banks must earn Gen Z's trust as they increasingly learn about finance from content creators on platforms like Instagram and YouTube. Educating young customers early can establish meaningful relationships and trust, says Chandralekha MR, founder of Dime.

item.title: Trump admin’s DOGE push saw federal paid leave surge 435% as costs hit $9.5 bn in 2025, says GAO; check key findings
item.description: The US spent $9.5 billion on federal employee administrative leave last year, with use increasing by 435%. This was linked to a deferred resignation program, costing about $6.7 billion, aimed at reducing the workforce.&nbsp;

item.title: Laid-off man with home loan worries about managing EMIs: ‘One email puts your entire life into uncertainty’
item.description: Debjit Sen, founder and CEO of Engrow, took to X to discuss the wider impact of layoffs on salaried employees. His post came soon after Oracle announced another round of job cuts.

item.title: Classic Connect, Gold Flake Super Star now more expensive: ITC hikes cigarette prices again
item.description: Higher tobacco taxes have led to increased cigarette prices, with ITC raising prices for Classic Connect and Gold Flake Super Star.

item.title: Niti Aayog VC pitches for export diversification to beat external headwinds
item.description: We shouldn't suffer from any export cynicism, says Ashok Lahiri, vice-chairman of Niti Aayog, while launching the June-quarter Trade Watch report.

item.title: Centre looks to widen trusted-trader programme beyond customs facilitation
item.description: CBIC has outlined five priorities for the AEO programme’s next decade, with a focus on technology, MSME access and closer coordination across agencies.

item.title: Social Security September 16 payment: Who gets paid today, and 2027 COLA forecast
item.description: Social Security provides several types of benefits depending on a person's circumstances.

item.title: Mumbai's Cafe Mondegar licence suspended: Improper food thawing, cooling lapses — what else did Maharashtra FDA flag?
item.description: The Maharashtra FDA, led by IAS officer Tukaram Mundhe, suspended the licences of Cafe Mondegar and three other establishments over alleged food safety violations, including improper food temperature maintenance and sanitation issues.

item.title: DRI seizes 232 kg of methamphetamine in northeast crackdown
item.description: The latest operation comes shortly after two DRI operations in August, near Silchar and Mizoram, in which the agency seized a combined 76 kg of methamphetamine tablets.

item.title: First legal challenge against UPI MDR filed in Supreme Court
item.description: The PIL argues that a change of this nature, affecting citizens at large, cannot be brought in through a press release.

item.title: US names India, China, Pakistan among major drug transit, illicit drug-producing countries
item.description: The designation covers 23 countries. The US determination makes clear that appearing on the list does not necessarily mean a government is failing to combat drug trafficking.

item.title: Food cart business over corporate job? Khadak Singh Da Dhaba CEO shares ₹75,000 + salary warning, risks and rewards
item.description: Khadak Singh Da Dhaba CEO Kawaljeet Singh warned corporate employees, especially those earning ₹75,000+, about the realities of entering the food cart business. He highlighted potential profits but also emphasised long hours, market challenges, and social stigma that come with the business.

item.title: US plans to deliver powerful weapons to Israel in $2.8 billion sale: What’s in the package and what it means
item.description: The proposed package has been informally communicated to congressional committees and is being pushed by the administration for approval.

item.title: Look beyond calls for tax leeway, FM tells industry
item.description: The minister appealed to tax professionals and institutions to not limit themselves to the sectors they represent and help bring independent tax policy research to become part of the public discourse.

item.title: King Charles and Prince William agree on THIS one thing about Prince Harry and Meghan
item.description: While Harry has been in recent contact with his father — including a July meeting with the King and Queen Camilla — tensions between Harry and Prince William remain strained, with no direct communication between the brothers.

item.title: Uber, Ola and other cab aggregators directed to cease advance tipping option; govt calls it ‘misleading, unfair’
item.description: The central government has ordered cab aggregators to stop pre-booking driver tips, labelling it misleading. This follows a ₹10 lakh fine on Rapido for unfair practices. The CCPA is also investigating Uber and Ola amid numerous consumer complaints regarding advance tipping.

item.title: Centre reconstitutes CBFC: Preity Zinta, Suniel Shetty, Pankaj Tripathi among 18 members | Full list here
item.description: The appointments are effective immediately and will remain valid for three years, until further notice.

item.title: UPI transaction charges: Petrol pump dealers seek full MDR exemption on payments above ₹2,000
item.description: UPI transaction charges: Petrol pump dealers have requested government intervention to eliminate MDR on UPI transactions exceeding ₹2,000, arguing that high fees undermine their income and run counter to efforts to promote digital payments.

item.title: Drone attack near Mecca ‘concerning’: India condemns attacks on Saudi Arabia — what did MEA say?
item.description: India expressed concern over the recent drone strike near Mecca, reaffirming its opposition to attacks on Saudi Arabia. The Ministry of External Affairs emphasised the need for peace and stability in the region, highlighting the incident's risk to civilians and critical infrastructure.

item.title: IMD forecasts heavy rain across several parts of India over next 7 days
item.description: The Andaman &amp; Nicobar Islands are expected to receive heavy rainfall in some parts on 17 September and again during 19-22 September, while fairly widespread to widespread rainfall is likely throughout the period.

item.title: Govt waives RCMC requirement for exports up to ₹3 lakh
item.description: Under the amended provision, exporters will not need an RCMC or certificate of registration for consignments with a free-on-board (FOB) value of up to ₹3 lakh.

item.title: Shahzad Bhatti Network declared a terrorist outfit under UAPA: What to know about Pakistan-based group
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced the designation of the Pakistan-based Shahzad Bhatti Network as a terrorist organisation under the UAPA, aimed at combating terrorism and protecting India's democratic integrity.

item.title: From Vizhinjam to Kasaragod: A 769-km journey through Keralam’s fractured infrastructure
item.description: An agonizing 33 km/hr cross-state drive along National Highway 66 lays bare the choked roads, delayed projects, and debt trap threatening Keralam’s economic future.

item.title: What is Article 10? The 1991 pact at the centre of India-Pakistan naval ship collision – explained
item.description: India summoned Pakistan's envoy after a Pakistani naval vessel collided with an Indian warship in the North Arabian Sea on Sept 15, violating the three-nautical-mile rule under the 1991 India-Pakistan pact. New Delhi calls the manoeuvre unsafe; no major damage was reported.

item.title: SC to decide fate of reassessment notices affecting taxpayers
item.description: The dispute is about whether regular jurisdictional assessing officers can issue reassessment notices to taxpayers or whether the notices must be issued through the faceless assessment system.

item.title: Canada may become the EU's first ‘associate member’: What could it get? From trade to defence and more
item.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed Canada as the EU’s first associate member to enhance economic and strategic ties. She emphasised expanding relations beyond trade agreements, aiming for a stronger strategic partnership while respecting nations' democratic choices.

item.title: EPFO wage ceiling raised to ₹25,000 from ₹15,000: Ashwini Vaishnaw
item.description: The Union cabinet has approved increasing the wage ceiling for Employees' Provident Fund coverage from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000, Information Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated.

item.title: Miss Universe India finalist returns to Google job in Bengaluru days after pageant
item.description: Miss Universe India 2026 finalist Umanga Kumawat has given followers a glimpse of her life after the pageant. Days after making it to the Top 20, the Google Cloud engineer was back at the company’s Bengaluru office, balancing meetings, workouts and coffee breaks with her corporate routine.

item.title: Bharat Forge, Pratt & Whitney join hands for India’s HALE programme: What it means for India’s UAV push
item.description: Bharat Forge and Pratt &amp; Whitney Canada will jointly evaluate turboprop engines for DRDO's HALE UAV programme, boosting India's indigenous drone push under Atmanirbhar Bharat. The move follows India's $203mn MQ-9B lease and an expanding domestic UAV ecosystem of 600+ companies.

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe's latest action plan on medical devices: MRP vs procurement prices revealed
item.description: After cracking down on Mumbai's food sector, Maharashtra FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe has turned to medical device pricing. A state survey found markups of up to 2,841% over procurement prices, prompting Mundhe to seek a review of pricing rules.

item.title: Time Magazine's ‘AI Tipping Point’ cover sparks debate online: 'AI fear mongering is stupid’
item.description: Time’s latest cover story examines growing concerns that increasingly powerful AI systems could become difficult for humans to control. The article has sparked a debate online, with some users backing the warnings while others call the narrative exaggerated and politically motivated.
